title: Milestone 3: Concurrent ETS Session Registry & Process Monitors (xmpp_session_registry)

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does xmpp_session_registry use erlang:monitor/2 instead of link/1 when tracking client C2S processes?
mentalModelCheck.codeSnippet:
MRef = erlang:monitor(process, C2sPid),
ets:insert(?TAB, {FullJid, BareJid, Resource, Priority, C2sPid, MRef})

options.label: Monitors are unidirectional: if a client connection drops, the registry receives a {'DOWN', ...} message without being killed by exit signals.
options.explanation: Correct! Process links are bidirectional and propagate exit signals. A client crash would crash the registry unless trapped. Monitors deliver a non-fatal message directly to handle_info/2.

options.label: Erlang only allows up to 1024 links per node, whereas monitors are unlimited.
options.explanation: BEAM supports millions of both links and monitors; the distinction is bidirectional exit propagation vs unidirectional messaging.

options.label: Monitors automatically restart crashed processes without a supervisor.
options.explanation: Monitors only notify the observer; supervisors are responsible for process restarts.
